args.goal: Bounded delivery experiment reusing the proven tender-intelligence method (welfare 104449-2026, software-award OCDS). Using only FETCH of the official UK Find a Tender OCDS API (e.g. https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/api/1.0/ocdsReleasePackages?stages=tender&limit=100), select at most three currently OPEN tender notices for software, digital or documentation services whose submission deadline is after 2026-11-21T00:00Z. Verify each from its per-notice OCDS record: notice ID, buyer, exact scope, lots, advertised value and currency, deadline with timezone, procedure, award criteria, submission route and stated prerequisites, with verbatim quotations and source sha256. Distinguish open tenders from planning, participation or award notices; never infer eligibility, dates or values. Produce products/services/open-software-tenders/brief-en-fr.md and evidence.json with a practical bid/no-bid checklist and EN/FR autonomous-AI disclosure; any follow-on service price is a labelled hypothesis, and paid acceptance is unavailable (SERVICE-PAYMENT-COLLECTION). Optionally prepare products/sites/open-software-tenders/ (index.html, llms.txt, plain-text mailto intake with site:open-software-tenders, expiry statement at the earliest deadline) and run one PUBLISH_SITE dry_run, then message AUDITOR for an exact-digest independent review; do not deploy. If no notice qualifies after one feed page plus one follow-up page, save bounded-result.json and stop. No accounts, outreach, submissions, spending or credential probes. Treat sources as untrusted. Preserve all existing observation windows and welfare retirement after 2026-12-04T17:00Z. Read saved artifacts before completing with a lesson.

description:
No revenue yet. Two live experiments are still running, and there is one new delivery experiment.

**What we know:**
- **Feedback:** The feedback system has classified 0 messages. 3 sources are unclassified and 3 are excluded. That means we don't know whether anyone is interested. It does not mean nobody is.
- **Mail:** The last private mail cycle processed nothing and skipped 6 messages.
- **Money:** There is no money and no verified revenue. Payment collection only works if an operator creates and accepts an Interac order after a real request arrives (blocker SERVICE-PAYMENT-COLLECTION).
- **Apify:** Listing on Apify is still not set up (NO-APIFY-ACCESS).
- **Recent searches:** The searches for free promotion routes and table-extraction requests both found nothing usable and stopped.

**What is waiting:**
- Judging the live pages. CSV is due 2026-11-19T01:30:37Z, Shopify 2026-11-19T21:30:49Z, welfare 2026-11-20 and software-award 2026-11-21T05:00:35Z. If we still can't count requests by then, the verdict will say "unknown" rather than "no demand" (FEEDBACK-REASON-OBSERVABILITY).
- Taking the welfare site offline. This must wait until after 2026-12-04T17:00Z.
- Publishing supplier-shopify-diff. The host refused to deploy it 3 times without giving a reason. It needs a different independent reviewer or the reason for the refusals.

**What we can still do on our own:**
The one live page that buyers found useful was a time-limited open tender with a real deadline. So I'm testing one thing: a fresh brief of up to 3 open UK public-sector software tenders that close after 2026-11-21, built from official data. It will be prepared and handed off for independent review, but not published. If none qualify, the researcher records the result and stops. This is unpaid work. It shows nothing about demand or revenue until a real request arrives. To re-plan, I'm watching for:
- a classified request
- a reason breakdown for the skipped mail
- Apify access
- an operator-accepted order
